title: Thanksgiving — The Pilgrims Thank God
objective: Students will learn the story of the Pilgrims and the first Thanksgiving.
content: A long time ago, people called Pilgrims sailed on a ship called the Mayflower to America. They wanted to be free to worship God!
The first winter was very hard. The Pilgrims were cold and hungry. But God helped them! Native Americans showed them how to plant corn and catch fish.
When the harvest came, the Pilgrims had plenty of food! They were so thankful to God that they had a big feast — the first Thanksgiving!
Every November, we celebrate Thanksgiving. We eat turkey and give thanks to God for all His blessings — just like the Pilgrims did!
activity: Make a Thanksgiving turkey by tracing your hand! Each finger is a feather. On each feather, write or draw one thing you are thankful to God for.
discussion: Why did the Pilgrims come to America?
Who helped the Pilgrims learn to grow food?
What do we celebrate at Thanksgiving?
